source: Seeded Cleo nightly improvement cache from current Atomix operating context until the first overnight research job runs.

actions.title: Run the day from CPO, not just headcount
actions.why: Labor only tells the truth when it is paired with shipped orders. A facility can look busy and still be margin-negative if hours are ahead of output.
actions.today: By 10 AM, have each facility call out orders shipped, CPO labor hours, and whether staffing should hold, flex down, or move departments.

actions.title: Close every blocker with an owner and proof
actions.why: Client trust is rebuilt by no repeats. A blocker that only lives in chat becomes a repeat miss, back-office drag, or client follow-up later.
actions.today: For every EOD fire/blocker, record owner, next action, expected closeout time, and proof location before noon.

actions.title: Protect inventory controls while pushing outbound speed
actions.why: Outbound speed without FEFO/lot/LPN discipline creates the most expensive kind of rework: client-impacting inventory uncertainty.
actions.today: Spot-check one high-volume outbound path and one expiry/lot-controlled client for scan discipline, exception handling, and supervisor signoff.
